$comment: The accessibility RATCHET, and the reason it exists.
axe was pointed at real pages for the first time on 2026-08-04. It found violations older
than the suite, so the counts are frozen per (surface, state, project): a RISE fails, a fall
is re-frozen. Same contract as scripts/adoption-baselines.json (ADR-928).
STATE AFTER THE 2026-08-04 FIX PASS: 40 contexts, 156 serious+ elements, 15 clean.
Down from 219. The whole of that -63 is /pricing going 21 -> 0 in all three light contexts:
its value ledger rendered 21 `text-success` "Included" cells on the canvas band at 4.05:1
rather than on white at 4.67:1. The table now declares its own surface.
WHAT IS STILL HERE, AND WHY THE AMBER SWEEP DID NOT MOVE IT:
- /spaces (44) and /the-community (39) render PUCK TEMPLATES, not the coded pages the
sweep edited. Their accent words come from accentize() in lib/page-editor/fields.tsx,
which emits <span class="text-primary"> and has no `ink` flag across its 32 call sites.
Fixing it is design-visible on every marketing page, so it is owner-gated, not deferred
out of laziness.
- A `text-text/10` watermark numeral measures 1.19:1 and would need alpha ~0.55 to clear.
- The .glass-ink hero dock overhangs a section seam and composites over the NEXT light
band, where even text-on-ink is only 4.35:1.
THIS NUMBER IS A FLOOR, NOT A CENSUS. axe returns INCOMPLETE rather than violation for any
element over a background-image, under a pseudo-element covering >25%, or at opacity 0. So
every ink band's contrast debt is unmeasured, and so is everything below the fold inside a
Reveal. Do not read a low number here as a clean page.
44 of the suite's 84 tests STILL DO NOT RUN: the member shell (/feed, /channels, /settings)
skips without PW_STORAGE_STATE and no seeded beta account exists. Those surfaces are
UNMEASURED, not clean. They carry no entry, so $defaultMax holds them at 0 -- the day the
storage state lands they will fail on their real debt. That failure is the point.
Every number here is debt with a date on it. Lower them; never raise them.
Re-freeze with: PW_A11Y_UPDATE=1 pnpm test:e2e:a11y && pnpm a11y:baselines
